1. Management Discussion & Analysis
Demand environment remains healthy and we continue to see strong order inflows across segments.
The quarter saw continued ramp-up of export volumes and firm domestic demand for precision
components. Capacity utilisation improved to 82%. The Board reviewed the funding plan for Phase II
and the company continues to evaluate a mix of internal accruals and term financing for the balance
capital expenditure.
“Liquidity remains strong, with comfortable cash buffers to fund our growth plans.”
Key risks include commodity price volatility, customer concentration, execution risks in the Phase II
expansion, and refinancing of term loans maturing in FY27.
Risk update
Commodity prices (specialty steel, aluminium alloys) remain elevated relative to prior year. The
company has partially hedged next-quarter requirements. Export customers contributed 34% of
revenue; the top five customers together contributed 41% of revenue.

2. Operational Highlights
Production volumes grew 6.5% quarter-on-quarter. The Phase II capacity expansion programme (₹480
crore) progressed on schedule; commissioning of the Chennai line-2 is expected in Q4 FY26.
“Our working capital discipline continues to improve, supported by better receivables
management.”
Headcount stood at 4,812. Employee cost for the quarter was ₹118 crore. Manpower productivity
improved 4% year-on-year on the back of automation initiatives.
Segment performance
Automotive components        52% of revenue      growth 10% YoY
Industrial machinery         31% of revenue      growth 15% YoY
Exports & others             17% of revenue      growth 9%  YoY
Customer concentration remains a monitored risk; the top five customers contribute 41% of revenue.

3. Statement of Profit & Loss
Revenue from operations for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 stood at ₹1,245 crore, up 8.2%
year-on-year.
EBITDA margin declined to 19.9% primarily on account of higher raw material costs, which rose to
52.4% of revenue (Q1 FY26: 52.4%).
Finance costs for the quarter were ₹28 crore (Q1 FY26: ₹28 crore), reflecting higher average
borrowings and effective interest rates.
Net profit for the quarter declined to ₹142 crore (Q1 FY26: ₹142 crore), impacted by higher finance
costs and margin compression.

6. Notes to the Accounts
Capital expenditure of ₹95 crore was incurred during the quarter towards the Phase II capacity
expansion (cumulative programme: ₹480 crore).
Term loans aggregating ₹180 crore mature in FY27 and are proposed to be refinanced. The company
is in discussion with lenders; sanction is expected in Q1 FY27.
